blocks.head: alt UserX is not near any device
alt UserX is near the device
alt UserX is near the device
alt UserX is near the device
alt A ticket of the device was issued more than 2 time units ago

state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

eq < system | ('counter' : N , ..) > < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ...) > < deviceB | (....) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB 
= < system | ('counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ...) > < deviceB | (....) > $ deviceB 'uploadSecret' cloudA | (randomStr('Secret', N)) .

eq < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('tickets' : Tickets , ...) , ....) > $ deviceB 'uploadSecret' cloudA | (Secret) 
= < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('tickets' : ((Secret , CurrentTime) , Tickets) , ...) , ....) > .

ceq < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ...) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('tickets' : ((Secret , Issued) , ....) , .....) , ......) > $ UserX 'getKey' cloudA 
= < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ...) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('tickets' : ((Secret , Issued) , ....) , .....) , ......) > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (Secret) if Issued == CurrentTime .

eq < UserX | ('knownSecrets' : Secrets , ..) > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (Secret) 
= < UserX | ('knownSecrets' : (Secret , Secrets) , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('knownSecrets' : (Secret , ..) , ...) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owner' : nils , 'tickets' : ((Secret , Issued) , ....) , .....) , ......) > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceB ; Secret) 
= < UserX | ('knownSecrets' : (Secret , ..) , ...) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owner' : UserX , 'tickets' : ((Secret , Issued) , ....) , .....) , ......) > .

eq < UserX | ('knownSecrets' : (Secret , ..) , ...) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owner' : Owner , 'tickets' : ((Secret , Issued) , ....) , .....) , ......) > $ UserX 'join' cloudA | (deviceB ; Secret) 
= < UserX | ('knownSecrets' : (Secret , ..) , ...) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owner' : (Owner , UserX , ..) , 'tickets' : ((Secret , Issued) , ....) , .....) , ......) > .

ceq < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('tickets' : ((Secret , Issued) , ...) , ....) , .....) > 
= < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('tickets' : nils , ....) , .....) > if CurrentTime - Issued > 2 .

=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .
